entries.brief: Original SKAZ D&D2014 fantasy reference-book spell illustration. Mature painterly realism, restrained natural colors, strong compact silhouette readable at32px on both dark navy and cream backgrounds, generous transparent margins. Single centered motif, no text, no UI, no border, no cartoon, no noisy scene. Heavy temple threshold guarded by a bright ruby-gold ward plane, a ghostlike clawed intruder unable to cross. Compact symbolic protected threshold, no padlock or printed rune.
